JWT Middleware to Support Cookies?
issue.body:
Today the JWT middleware only works with authorization headers and not cookies
```
const credentials = ctx.req.headers.get('Authorization')
```

What if an optional param to the options:
```
export const jwt = (options: { secret: string; alg?: string; cookie?: string }) => {
```

Then the above code could be modified to something like:
```
const credentials = ctx.req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? ctx.req.cookie[cookie]
```

What do you think?

issue.title: The results of `context.param` are URL-encoded
issue.body:
## Current behavior

URL: http://localhost:8000/%C3%A7awa%20y%C3%AE%3F

Code:

```ts
app.get("/:text", () => {
  console.log(context.param("text"));
})
```

Output:

```ts
%C3%A7awa%20y%C3%AE%3F
```

## Expected behavior

URL: http://localhost:8000/%C3%A7awa%20y%C3%AE%3F

Code:

```ts
app.get("/:text", () => {
  console.log(context.param("text"));
})
```

Output:

```ts
çawa yî?
```

#### Version: 2.4.0

issue.title: Cache middleware
JSX performance improvement
issue.body:
In #435, we found that JSX in hono is not that fast, so we will improve performance.

### Key points for improvement

#### Make `escape` faster

We can make `escape` faster by avoiding using `String.prototype.replace`, as we do in react.

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/3f3b46c845333be5d8efcd9acb06e3ff57358189/packages/react-dom/src/server/escapeTextForBrowser.js#L51-L94

#### Reduce generation of string objects

Adding strings to the buffer reduces the generation of string objects.

#### Avoid `Array.prototype.flat(Infinity)`

`Array.prototype.flat(Infinity)` is very useful, but it is slow and should not be used.


### POC

https://github.com/honojs/hono/compare/main...usualoma:hono:poc-pref-jsx

#### Benchmark

```
Hono x 246,570 ops/sec ±1.04% (88 runs sampled)
React x 132,325 ops/sec ±9.23% (82 runs sampled)
Preact x 100,303 ops/sec ±4.16% (83 runs sampled)
Nano x 24,140 ops/sec ±6.48% (82 runs sampled)
Fastest is Hono
```

I think we ought to get this done!

issue.title: Middleware is bypassed when get("*") is used
Named Parameters applying to routes differently with TrieRouter than RegExpRouter
issue.body:
Hey, thank you for the work on the library.

I was following some of the instructions in the docs and changed one of the examples and noticed some unexpected behavior.

```
// Snippet changed slightly from the docs here.
// https://honojs.dev/docs/api/routing/#routing-priority

app.get("/book/a", (c) =>
  c.text(c.req.param("slug") || "no-slug"))
)
app.get("/book/:slug", (c) =>
  c.text(c.req.param("slug") || "no-slug-at-slug-endpoint")
)
```

Hitting the endpoints, I get the following results.

```
$ curl http://localhost:8787/book/a
a
$ curl http://localhost:8787/book/foo
foo
```

The TrieRouter unexpectedly seems to be applying the Named Parameter parsing rule from the second route to the first.

If I use the `RegExpRouter` instead, I get the results I expect.

```
$ curl http://localhost:8787/book/a
no-slug
$ curl http://localhost:8787/book/foo
foo
```

issue.title: [Bug] returns 404 using RegExpRouter
issue.body:
The following code using RegExpRouter, `POST /posts` will return "404 Not Found" response, the Hono version is `v2.1.3`. And it wIll be "Internal Server Error" In the current tree https://github.com/honojs/hono/tree/e174b7085821164877e46b62cc3f56dcf81b4b77.

```ts
import { Hono } from 'hono'
import { RegExpRouter } from 'hono/router/reg-exp-router'

const app = new Hono({ router: new RegExpRouter() })

app.get('/posts', (c) => c.text('foo'))
app.post('/posts', (c) => c.text('foo'))
app.get('/posts/page/:page', (c) => c.text('foo'))
app.get('/posts/:id/comments', (c) => c.text('foo'))
```

```
$ curl -X POST http://localhost:8787/posts
404 Not Found%
```

The same problem does not occur with TrieRouter.

issue.title: next() is called multiple times in Deno when staticFileHandler fails to find a file
Hono/validator: Unexpected end of JSON input
issue.body:
When using something like the following, and there being an invalid request body (e.g. malformed json, or no body at all), the library throws an unexpected end of json error, with status 500.
```js
validator((v) => ({
  email: v
    .json("email")
    .isRequired()
}))
```

It should probably throw a 400 error instead 🙂

issue.body:

issue.title: Path templates with parameter prefix
issue.body:
Sort of a follow up from #569 but figured it was a subtly different issue. Having renamed the parameter, I've found the router doesn't match a longer path template if it first matches a shorter one.

I've put together a failing test here: https://github.com/honojs/hono/compare/main...gatesn:hono:ngates/prefix-params?expand=1

I believe this can be fixed by removing this `break`: https://github.com/honojs/hono/blob/13ce2eef950f8eb11fe219280b0d5f61bd4fbec1/src/router/trie-router/node.ts#L190

But I'm not familiar enough with the code base to know whether that's correct, or just happens to work in this case.

Many thanks for this project, it's incredibly useful and a pleasure to use :)

issue.title: `checked` in JSX middleware
issue.body:
When I want to set the value of attributes according to the condition which is true or false, it is to be:

```tsx
<input value={true ? 'foo' : 'bar'} />
```

But how can I make the checkbox to be unchecked?
Can I render `checked` if it is true, or **do not** render the `checked` if it is false:

I want to make the below tag:

```tsx
<input type='checkbox' checked /> <!-- If true -->
<input type='checkbox' /> <!-- If false -->
```

But, I can't:

```tsx
<input type='checkbox' checked={false}/> <!-- NG: It will be checked -->
<input type='checkbox' {true ? 'checked' : ''}/> <!-- NG: Syntax error, and it will be checked -->
```

How can I remove `checked` if it is false? I think we should implement it.

Ref: [html - What values for checked and selected are false? - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/4228658/what-values-for-checked-and-selected-are-false)
